Title: Logic Apps Standard Plan updates in general availability

Body.Content:
We are announcing general availability updates to the Logic Apps Standard Plan to help enterprise integration between mission critical systems on cloud, on premises, and in a hybrid way with runtime available on Azure, Azure Arc and locally. 

The following general availability features have been added to the Logic Apps Standard Plan:

  • The Logic Apps designer is updated for complex and advanced workflows- with improved designer initial load performance, improved performance for workflows with composite action shapes (condition, switch), improved runtime performance on stateless workflows and buil-tin connector performance.
  • Managed identity support for various built-in operations and connectors

Learn more about the updates.
